title: Accounts Payable  Specialist - Mumbai
about: The Accounts Payable Specialist will manage end-to-end vendor operations, including vendor onboarding, PR/PO creation, and invoice auditing in SAP. Responsibilities also include maintaining real-time tracking systems in Excel, processing employee expense reimbursements, and coordinating with Finance teams to ensure smooth payment cycles.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (2020 - 2023 Batches (2–4 Years Experience Required)). Hands-on skills in SAP ERP, Microsoft Excel, Procurement Workflows preferred.

items: Numerical Ability & Financial Math
Data Interpretation (Spreadsheets)
Logical Reasoning
Excel Automation (Macros/VBA)
Data Cleaning & Auditing Logic
Basic SQL Queries
Be ready to demonstrate hands-on familiarity with SAP modules for PR/PO creation, vendor master records, and invoice tracking.
Prepare practical examples of 3-way invoice matching, handling vendor discrepancies, and managing employee expense auditing.

title: Associate - Motor Insurance
about: Responsible for driving motor insurance sales by engaging with potential customers to convert digital and telesales leads for two-wheelers, private cars, and commercial vehicles. Assists clients in selecting suitable policy coverage, add-ons, and renewals while managing customer data and pipelines in CRM systems. Strives to meet daily and monthly sales targets while providing lead quality feedback to improve conversion strategies.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (Any Graduate (2020 - 2024 Batches)). Hands-on skills in MS Excel, Google Sheets, CRM Tools preferred.

items: Verbal Ability & Persuasive Communication
Numerical Reasoning & Percentages
Data Interpretation (Sales & Conversion Rates)
Motor Insurance Concepts (IDV, NCB Transfers)
Comprehensive vs. Third-Party Cover Mechanics
IRDAI Guidelines & Regulatory Basics
Be prepared to explain core motor insurance terminology such as Insured Declared Value (IDV), No Claim Bonus (NCB), and add-on covers like Zero Depreciation during technical domain discussions.
Showcase a target-oriented mindset, comfortable pitch handling, and strong objection-handling abilities during the sales/HR interview round.

title: Associate - TA Tech
about: Manage end-to-end technology recruitment and volume hiring initiatives at Paytm across multiple tech functions. Responsibilities include active candidate sourcing via LinkedIn and Naukri, organizing virtual or walk-in hiring drives, and collaborating with engineering managers. You will manage candidate pipelines, track recruitment MIS metrics, and ensure smooth offer-to-joining conversion.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (2021 - 2024 Batches (Any Graduate with recruitment experience)). Hands-on skills in Tech Recruitment, LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri RMS preferred.

items: Data Interpretation (Hiring MIS)
Logical Reasoning
Verbal & Business Communication
Tech Stack Fundamentals (Java, Python, React)
Software Engineering Roles Knowledge
Fintech System Concepts
Highlight your hands-on experience with tech talent sourcing channels like LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and community referrals.
Be prepared to discuss recruitment metrics such as offer acceptance ratio, turn-around time (TAT), and volume drive execution strategies.

title: Business Analyst
about: Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights, drive business growth, and optimize operational efficiency at Paytm. Key responsibilities include writing complex SQL queries, building interactive Power BI dashboards, and automating recurring business reports. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional product and marketing teams to present data-backed recommendations to leadership.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (2020 - 2023 Batches (2-5 years experience required)). Hands-on skills in SQL, Power BI, Excel preferred.

items: Data Interpretation
Logical Reasoning
Business Acumen
Quantitative Aptitude
SQL Window Functions & CTEs
Complex SQL Joins & Aggregations
Database Query Optimization
Basic Python Data Analysis
Practice writing live SQL queries using Window Functions, Group By, and Subqueries on complex schema examples.
Prepare a clear case study explaining a Power BI dashboard you built, focusing on key business metrics and visualization choices.
Familiarize yourself with Paytm's ecosystem and fintech KPIs such as GMV, CAC, Retention, and User Activation rates.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
about: The Credit Risk Analyst at Paytm is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing digital lending portfolios across consumer and merchant products. The candidate will design risk strategies, perform loss forecasting, and leverage tools like SQL and Python to extract actionable business insights. Additionally, the role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to balance risk management with overall lending growth.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (2021 - 2024 Batches (2-5 years relevant experience required)). Hands-on skills in SQL, Python, PySpark preferred.

items: Data Interpretation
Logical Reasoning
Quantitative Aptitude
Probability & Statistics
Advanced SQL Queries & Joins
Data Wrangling with Pandas
Credit Risk Modeling Concepts
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Focus heavily on SQL window functions, data aggregation, and basic machine learning algorithms applied to credit scoring and risk management.
Be ready to explain fintech domain concepts like Bureau scores, DPD (Days Past Due), default rates, and case studies on portfolio risk containment.

title: CST - Associate - Bill Payments CST
about: As a CST Associate for Bill Payments at Paytm, you will handle and resolve day-to-day queries and complaints from customers and merchants via call and chat. You will be responsible for meeting defined turnaround times (TAT) while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Additionally, you will assist in managing operational tasks and maintaining brand consistency across support channels.
eligibility: Open to graduates in relevant streams (2023, 2024 & 2025 Batches (Any Graduate)). Hands-on skills in CRM Tools, Ticketing Systems, MS Excel preferred.

items: Verbal Ability & Grammar
Reading Comprehension
Logical Reasoning
Situational Judgment Test (SJT)
Not Applicable (Non-Tech Role)
Basic Troubleshooting Logic
Workflow & Process Logic
Focus on demonstrating excellent written and verbal communication skills as call/chat management is central to the role.
Prepare scenario-based answers showing empathy, patience, and quick problem-solving skills when handling angry customers or merchants.
